When choosing a VPS for a production website, it's easy to focus on the advertised CPU cores, RAM and storage. But those specifications don't always tell us how a server will perform under real workloads.

A cheaper VPS might handle a lightweight website perfectly well, while another server with similar specifications could struggle with database queries, traffic spikes or heavy background tasks.

I think a few factors deserve more attention before making a hosting decision:
